title: Grievance Feedback Mechanism
body:
Grievance Feedback Mechanism

The Toledo Institute for Development and Environment (TIDE) provides this Grievance and Feedback Mechanism  to ensure that all stakeholders, rights holders, and community members can safely and confidentially submit concerns related to TIDE’s activities or BMPAN network activities.

All grievances are received respectfully and handled according to the standardized Belize Marine Protected Areas Network (BMPAN) process, including optional anonymity, confidentiality, non-retaliation, and survivor-centered principles. 

This form is available on the current TIDE website. Open the original form.
